Container.Name: ucg-config-backup
Container.Overview: Logs in to the local UniFi OS API of a UCG Ultra (or another UniFi OS console), triggers a config backup and downloads it on a cron schedule. The console needs no cloud connection. Old backups are deleted after RETENTION_DAYS; failures (and optionally successes) can be sent to a webhook. Progress is in the container log.

Config.Name: Backup Directory
Config.Description: Where the .unf backup files are stored

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: 002: new files are writable for the users group, e.g. over SMB

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the schedule and the log

Config.Name: UCG_HOST
Config.Description: IP address or host name of the UCG Ultra / UniFi OS console

Config.Name: UCG_USERNAME
Config.Description: Local admin user dedicated to backups (no cloud/SSO account, no 2FA)

Config.Name: VERIFY_SSL
Config.Description: Check the console's TLS certificate (UniFi OS ships a self-signed one)

Config.Name: CRON_SCHEDULE
Config.Description: When the backup runs (cron: minute hour day month weekday)

Config.Name: RETENTION_DAYS
Config.Description: Delete local backups older than N days (0 = keep everything)

Config.Name: RUN_ON_START
Config.Description: Run a backup right after the container starts

Config.Name: NOTIFY_ON_SUCCESS
Config.Description: Also notify the webhook on success, not only on failure

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_URL
Config.Description: Optional: URL for POST notifications (ntfy.sh, Healthchecks.io, Home Assistant webhook). Usually contains a secret

Config.Name: WEBHOOK_FORMAT
Config.Description: text (plain text, ntfy.sh/Healthchecks.io) or json (structured fields, Home Assistant)
